latest_release.name: 2.13.2 - 2026 Release (In-Dev)
latest_release.body:
**This release is considered an in-development version:**
- The CLI is currently in the middle of a rewrite, so it's not functional at this time (use [v2.12](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/releases/tag/v2.12)).

# Notable Changes
+ [Use the native menubar on MacOS](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/6ae8d8f2378d6871b9fb1942bd23e47b055d6731) - @oraveczandrew 
+ [Adequate Russian translation, finally](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/6f3acd64aeba9994df0f6126c67754f55a445415) - @lustman
+ [Binary viewer library update](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/ad61ea6f38aaae0d1212c15648d8d452a042609c) - @hajdam
+ [Obfuscator removed.](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/0723397794b81069a8b62b4ddb2dbecf5da6c757) - @lustman
+ [These usages break text direction, switching to right-to-left (RTL) instead of the expected left-to-right (LTR).](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/320905102e16dae1368ae9d959c9a450fabddc20) - @CyberGhost13337
+ [Build: add Java 25 LTS](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/66d4b6139b16a494d1f3d9315cd15c4a57ce2a26) - @SoKnight
+ [Build: update asm to 9.9](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/10206dd9683b00226296ed7f2d7385dc593fd7ac) - @SoKnight
+ [Add missing translation key in English and German](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/282ca117eba5685148bfbfb0894b531f817970b0) - @ThexXTURBOXx
+ [Update Maven plugins](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/5acfe7a7f0c9e84b7eb8b80e1d82684a787872aa) - @ThexXTURBOXx

# January 6th, 2026 Fixes:
+ 2.13.2 has been **re-released**, on January 6th, 2026. If you have downloaded it previously, and need to open APKs - redownload it again for the following fixes:
   + [Fix Dex2Jar Classfiles Incorrectly Showing On Windows](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/aab9a9ec5fe693954168286bdd5628964d19abc5) - @Konloch
   + [Fix APK Decoded Resources Folder On Windows](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/02b58ae6f4caa57b9688f814e344cb12995318da) - @Konloch
   + [Update APK Tool API](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/commit/591486fbf0c82039c5915ea766b88110771c12b2) - @Konloch

# Note
If you encounter any issues, try an older version: [v2.12](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/releases/tag/v2.12), [v2.11.2](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/releases/tag/v2.11.2), [v2.13.1](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/releases/tag/v2.13.1)

If you find any bugs just [open up a GitHub issue](https://github.com/Konloch/bytecode-viewer/issues/new) or email me at Konloch@gmail.com
